output.proposed_rendering:
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that what has happened to me has actually helped the good news move forward. Everyone in the imperial guard, along with everyone else, now knows that I am in prison because I belong to Christ. My imprisonment has made most of the believers more confident in the Lord, and they now speak God’s message with greater courage and without fear.

Some preach Christ because they are jealous and want to compete with me, while others do it from good motives. Those who act out of love know that I am here to defend the good news. The others preach Christ from selfish ambition and not from sincere motives. They think they can make my imprisonment even harder. But what really matters is that Christ is being proclaimed, whether the motives are false or sincere. That is why I rejoice and will continue to rejoice!
